record.body:
## Problem

The status tabs always split over two rows (`STATUS_TABS[:4]` / `[4:]`), even at 120 columns, and do not show their number keys. The phase stepper wraps by the app width, not the pane's inner width, so at 60 columns a phase glyph can end one line and its label start the next. Phase detail shows blank lines above each `##` heading in the phase body.

## Approach

- Status tabs (`EffortPane` in `scripts/dashboard_app.py`): lay the six tabs out in one row when they fit the pane, and wrap only when they do not. Show each tab's number key, e.g. `1 Active 5`.
- Stepper: wrap by the pane's inner width and never split a glyph from its label.
- Phase detail: remove the top margin of Markdown headings in the phase body so no blank lines sit above a heading; check the task detail description for the same issue.

## Exit criteria

- Pilot tests: six tabs on one row at 120 columns and wrapped at 60, with number keys; no stepper line starts with a bare label or ends with a bare glyph at 60 columns; no blank line above a heading in phase detail.
- A tmux popup test shows the one-row tabs and the stepper at side-pane width; the full suite passes.
